title: Warmest day of the week
hints: Handle the empty list first. Then remember the index of the best day so far and compare every day against it.
Start with `best = 0` (day 0 is the warmest *so far*). Loop with `for i, temp in enumerate(temps):` and move `best` to `i` when `temp` is **strictly** warmer than `temps[best]`.
`if not temps: return None`, `best = 0`, `for i, temp in enumerate(temps): if temp > temps[best]: best = i`, then `return best`
